text: Why study in CUFE 1.Located on a main campus in the heart of Beijing. 2.One of the leading comprehensive universities in China. 3.Provide a modern, convenient and safe international students’ apartment 4.High quality faculty---350 are professors and associate professors among a total of 670 full-time faculty members. 5.One of the national "211" key universities. 6.The first university of finance and economics in the Republic created by the China's central government. Program Introduction The program is designed to equip students with advanced skills in economic theory and econometrics. The emphasis is on development of students’ analytical skills, in particular their ability to identify key questions and to use theoretical and empirical tools to answer them. Teaching Objective To prepare students to be talents with global competencies, intellectual and practical skills, personal development and social responsibility, integrative learning, openness, development and inequality. Main Courses Principles of Management,macro-economics,Management Information System,Statistics, Marketing,Economic Law, Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance Management Fee Structure Tuition fee: 26000RMB/year Insurance: RMB 600/ per year, RMB 400/per half year Internship The university has special apartment to help international student find internship chances in good companies and organizations. Duration 2 years Degree Awarded Master of Economics Future Career Banking, consultancy, accountancy, marketing, advertising, human resource management and general management.
